entries.name: Button
entries.description: Triggers an immediate action or submits a form.

entries.name: Icon Button
entries.description: A compact action represented by a familiar icon and accessible label.

entries.name: Button Group
entries.description: A visually related set of actions.

entries.name: Split Button
entries.description: Pairs a primary action with a menu of related actions.

entries.name: Floating Action Button
entries.description: A prominent floating action for a primary mobile task.

entries.name: Link
entries.description: Navigates to another resource or location.

entries.name: Text Input
entries.description: Collects a short line of text.

entries.name: Textarea
entries.description: Collects multi-line freeform text.

entries.name: Search Input
entries.description: Collects a query and communicates search behavior.

entries.name: Password Input
entries.description: Collects secret text with reveal and security affordances.

entries.name: Number Input
entries.description: Collects a numeric value with appropriate constraints.

entries.name: OTP / PIN Input
entries.description: Collects a short verification or identification code.

entries.name: Checkbox
entries.description: Selects zero or more independent options.

entries.name: Radio
entries.description: Selects exactly one option from a visible set.

entries.name: Switch
entries.description: Immediately toggles a binary setting.

entries.name: Segmented Control
entries.description: Switches between a small set of mutually exclusive views or values.

entries.name: Select
entries.description: Chooses one option from a compact list.

entries.name: Combobox
entries.description: Combines text input with a filterable option list.

entries.name: Autocomplete
entries.description: Suggests completions while the user types.

entries.name: Multi-select
entries.description: Chooses multiple values from a compact option list.

entries.name: Date Input
entries.description: Collects a date through a formatted text or native field.

entries.name: Date Picker
entries.description: Chooses a date using a calendar overlay or panel.

entries.name: Date Range Picker
entries.description: Chooses a start and end date as one interval.

entries.name: Calendar
entries.description: Displays dates and related events in a calendar grid.

entries.name: Time Picker
entries.description: Chooses a time of day.

entries.name: Date-Time Picker
entries.description: Chooses a date and time together.

entries.name: Breadcrumb
entries.description: Shows location in a hierarchy and enables upward navigation.

entries.name: Tabs
entries.description: Switches among peer views while preserving context.

entries.name: Sidebar
entries.description: Persistent vertical navigation or contextual tools.

entries.name: Navigation Menu
entries.description: Organizes destinations in a site or application.

entries.name: Menubar
entries.description: Desktop-style hierarchy of commands and submenus.

entries.name: Pagination
entries.description: Moves between pages of a large collection.

entries.name: Stepper
entries.description: Communicates progress through an ordered multi-step flow.

entries.name: Command Palette
entries.description: Searches and invokes application commands from one overlay.

entries.name: Dialog
entries.description: Temporarily focuses attention on a task above the current page.

entries.name: Alert Dialog
entries.description: Interrupts for an important confirmation or acknowledgement.

entries.name: Drawer
entries.description: A panel that enters from an edge without replacing the page.

entries.name: Sheet
entries.description: A supplementary surface anchored to an edge, often on mobile.

entries.name: Popover
entries.description: A contextual non-modal surface anchored to a trigger.

entries.name: Tooltip
entries.description: A brief label or hint revealed on hover or focus.

entries.name: Hover Card
entries.description: A richer preview revealed from a linked subject.

entries.name: Dropdown Menu
entries.description: A contextual list of actions opened from a trigger.

entries.name: Context Menu
entries.description: Actions relevant to a target, opened through a contextual gesture.

entries.name: Alert
entries.description: Communicates a persistent important message in context.

entries.name: Toast
entries.description: Briefly confirms an outcome without blocking work.

entries.name: Banner
entries.description: Communicates page- or system-level information prominently.

entries.name: Progress
entries.description: Shows completion of a determinate or indeterminate process.

entries.name: Spinner
entries.description: Indicates indeterminate short activity.

entries.name: Skeleton
entries.description: Preserves layout while content is loading.

entries.name: Empty State
entries.description: Explains an empty collection and an appropriate next step.

entries.name: Status Indicator
entries.description: Shows a compact state through text, icon, or color.

entries.name: Table
entries.description: Displays structured values in rows and columns.

entries.name: Data Table
entries.description: Adds sorting, selection, filtering, or actions to tabular data.

entries.name: List
entries.description: Displays a sequence of related items.

entries.name: Tree
entries.description: Displays nested hierarchical items with expansion.

entries.name: Card
entries.description: Groups a compact subject and its related information or actions.

entries.name: Badge
entries.description: Shows compact status, count, or classification metadata.

entries.name: Tag
entries.description: Labels or represents a value that may be removable.

entries.name: Avatar
entries.description: Represents a person, team, or entity with an image or initials.

entries.name: Timeline
entries.description: Shows events in chronological order.

entries.name: Accordion
entries.description: Reveals and hides stacked sections of content.

entries.name: Carousel
entries.description: Moves through a bounded sequence in one viewport.

entries.name: Statistic / KPI
entries.description: Highlights an important value with context.

entries.name: Chart
entries.description: Visualizes quantitative relationships or change.

entries.name: Sparkline
entries.description: Shows a compact trend without a full chart frame.

entries.name: Gauge
entries.description: Shows a value against a bounded range.

entries.name: Progress Visualization
entries.description: Summarizes progress across stages or categories.

entries.name: Container
entries.description: Constrains and aligns a content region.

entries.name: Stack
entries.description: Arranges children along one axis with consistent spacing.

entries.name: Flex
entries.description: Arranges flexible items along one dimension.

entries.name: Grid
entries.description: Arranges content across two-dimensional tracks.

entries.name: Divider
entries.description: Separates adjacent content groups.

entries.name: Scroll Area
entries.description: Constrains scrolling to a named region.

entries.name: Resizable Panels
entries.description: Lets users adjust the space allocated to adjacent regions.

entries.name: Aspect Ratio
entries.description: Maintains a proportional media or content box.

entries.name: Field
entries.description: Composes a label, control, description, and validation message.

entries.name: Fieldset
entries.description: Groups related form controls under one legend.

entries.name: Label
entries.description: Names an input or control accessibly.

entries.name: File Upload
entries.description: Selects or drops one or more files for upload.

entries.name: Slider
entries.description: Chooses a value or range along a continuum.

entries.name: Rating
entries.description: Collects or displays an ordinal assessment.

entries.name: Clipboard
entries.description: Copies a value with explicit feedback.

entries.name: Keyboard Shortcut
entries.description: Displays a key combination for an action.
